metadata.short_desc: Dark glass multi-tab web shell with custom blurred backgrounds and file manager
metadata.desc: A real shell inside AstrBot WebUI with browser-style tabs, custom blurred image backgrounds, a file manager, ECDH + AES-256-GCM encrypted transport, an admin-only /terminal command and an LLM shell tool.

enabled.hint: When disabled, the view cannot create encrypted sessions or terminals.

shell.hint: Leave empty for automatic selection: pwsh.exe / powershell.exe on Windows, $SHELL on Linux/macOS.

cwd.hint: Leave empty for the current user's home directory. Must exist.

file_manager_root.hint: The file manager can only access this directory. Leave empty for the home directory.

file_manager_max_mb.hint: Maximum size for upload, download and preview operations.

max_sessions.hint: Upper bound for simultaneously alive terminal tabs.

idle_timeout.hint: Terminals with no input or output for this long are closed automatically. Default: 1800.

allow_background_upload.hint: Allow users to upload a custom blurred background image. Images are stored in the plugin data directory.

max_upload_mb.hint: The frontend compresses images, so uploads are usually much smaller.

session_ttl.hint: Idle lifetime of the AES key derived from ECDH. The page re-negotiates automatically.

terminal.title: Terminal Shell
terminal.description: Multi-tab web shell with custom blurred backgrounds and encrypted transport.

files.title: File Manager
files.description: Browse, upload, download, rename and delete files under the configured root.
